beats.display_text: Idea two. Delete is a cliff. Write-on adds two gentler slopes before it.
The first is Ghost. Press Ctrl+/ and the text fades almost to nothing, but stays exactly where it was.
Now you can read the paragraph as if it were gone. If it reads better, leave it ghosted. If not, bring it back.
The second is Overflow. A line you love, but that doesn't belong here, goes to the side with Ctrl+Shift+X, and waits until you want it back.
So instead of keep or delete, you get a dial. Keep it, hold a variant, ghost it, overflow it, and only then, delete.
